original.statement: In 0.46.0 the standalone User Operator handles a missing Cluster CA cert Secret when TLS is not needed.

decision.reason: [ev-35ea1afad43d] says the standalone User Operator was updated to handle the Cluster CA cert Secret being missing when TLS is not needed. That is a change in how a named component behaves at runtime, so behavior-changed is the right type. No configuration key, field, flag or variable is named, so the free-form protocol-behavior family is the closest fit. The kebab-case name "cluster-ca-cert-secret-missing" uses the evidence's own words, and "User Operator" is copied exactly from the text as the component.
